question: In the simplest law that keeps IOTA's amplitude ledger, vacuum budget, and exhaustion (IOTA-MIN-L0), does single-seed activity persist exactly when the fresh vacuum percolates, and is the growth at the persistence threshold in the dynamic-percolation class?
motivation: directed percolation and dynamic isotropic percolation are the established, experimentally observed theories of whether locally propagated activity persists or dies; they supply externally fixed exponents against which an IOTA persistence claim can fail

stages.name: implementation and structure audit of IOTA-MIN-L0, plus L1 analytic check
stages.gate: answers, synthetic tests, and prediction record committed

stages.name: IOTA-MIN-L0 single-seed spreading over vacuum occupation rho

stage_order: C and A may run in either order; S opens only after both gates; K opens only after S
outcome_boundary: no registered random medium may be drawn and no rho sweep run before the freeze commit and its tag
Stage C calibration outcomes may be generated only after the freeze; a failing calibration ends this version
Stage A may use only disclosed synthetic states (structural_audit.json outcome_boundary)
the prediction record is committed before Stage S opens and is never revised from Stage S data
required_before_freeze: resolve every pending verification in reference_classes.json

implement the IOTA-MIN-L0 engine (a new module; src/iota_rig.py is not modified), the calibration models, the shared estimator and classifier, and an independent replay of the engine, estimator, and classifier

engine tests on synthetic media: exact ledger, exact absorbing certificate, light cone, determinism under the declared RNG streams, and an identical final activated set to CAL-SITE-BFS-SC-3 (timing may differ) on media where the budget cannot bind (every activated site has at most v + 1 fresh neighbours)
classifier tests on synthetic ledgers with exact DP and DyP power laws and an exact s^-(tau-2) cluster tail
a content-hash outcome seal with every run command disabled

changes: estimators.json bracketing.bisection: a critical_compatible midpoint now replaces the endpoint with the larger |s|, so bisection continues toward the endpoint nearer the threshold (SPEC_QUESTIONS.md Q-EST-8); the v0.1 text moved the bracket away from the threshold
the estimator, its independent replay, and their tests implement that rule
three seal and CLI tests that assumed no registered artifact exists now check that existing registered artifacts are tracked and that tests leave them unchanged
COMPUTE_ESTIMATE.md records the outcome-free resource projection

opening_rule: linear history as in prior ICP protocols: the seal-introduction commit is tagged with the annotated freeze tag; each open manifest is added alone in a direct child; each result is written atomically exactly once and committed alone in the direct child of its opening

deferred_stage.name: role-level persistence and replacement near criticality
hypotheses_for_a_later_freeze: role-continuing successor counts of a tracked organization, treated as the active unit, show an absorbing transition in the same class as lattice activity
the fraction of partial carrier replacements that a role survives falls toward zero as the lattice-activity critical point is approached (noise-sensitivity prediction)
deferred_stage.requirement: an already-frozen role detector referenced by content hash

claim_limits: a result for IOTA-MIN-L0; transfer to richer IOTA laws only through the registered ladder
not role or organization persistence (deferred stage R)
not novelty for percolation, DP, or DyP physics
effective exponents at L = 64 over the registered window
law: minimal_law.json laws.L0; L1 analytic only; the canonical v0.3.6 law is reached later through minimal_law.json ablation_ladder
why_minimal: a universality-class or threshold match is evidence only if the law was not tuned to produce it; the canonical law accreted mechanisms across versions, so the registered test runs on the minimal law and each mechanism is restored one rung at a time

icp_mapping.research_path_rung: ICP manuscript Section 8, Rung 1, which requires comparison against branching/percolation rivals; this protocol supplies that percolation null for the IOTA substrate
icp_mapping.F001_reading: H1 'equal' means minimal-IOTA persistence is fully accounted for by site percolation of the medium, the rival null; the amplitude ledger then adds no persistence content at this rung. H1 'budget_shifted' is a measurable effect of the embodied budget beyond connectivity, which is a candidate (not a demonstration) of the 'prediction beyond complete-state ordinary dynamics' that ICP criterion F001 demands; the complete-state L0 dynamics still explains it, so ICP content would require the shift to survive the ladder and carrier interventions
icp_mapping.L1_reading: the analytic immortality of activity under any reactivation channel moves ICP's carrier-succession question entirely to role-level persistence (deferred stage R), consistent with ICP Pilot Batch 05's novelty target: formation and transport of a constraint role through replacement of the original witness
